Name: Devour
Description:
Restores 70 HP on activation and grants Devour for 10+5 seconds. Reactivating Devour restores 70 HP and refreshes 5+3 seconds.
Scoring a kill while Devour is active restores 70 HP, grants Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5+3 seconds of its duration.

Grenade Ability Energy on Kill:
Tier 1 Combatant = 7.5% | T2 = 11.6% | T3 = 13.75% | T4 = 20% | Guardians = 20%

Name: Invisibility
Description:
Cloaks the user, granting various benefits, while lowering Maximum Radar Range to 24 meters for 5+2 seconds. Immediately ends upon performing an Offensive Action.
 Radar Booster Weapon Mod removes the Radar Reduction. Reapplying Invisibility without it breaking refreshes the duration of the longest lasting invisibility.

Combatants are unable to directly target the user, preferring to either shoot at the user's last visible location, or not firing. Combatants will track through Loud Actions, but not fire.

Guardians are unable to see the user's health bar, and the user's radar will only ping every 5 seconds for 0.6 seconds, or upon performing Loud Actions.

Weapons and Abilities that are able to home in (Tracking Projectiles) or scan (Firebolt Grenades) for enemies will not target the user, and will stop tracking if they already were. 

Offensive Actions: Instantly ends Invisibility
Shooting | Grenade, Melee, Super, or Blink Ability Usage | Barricade or Rift Placement | Vehicle Summon

Loud Actions: Pings Radar | Combatants Track
Beginning Sprint | Non-Blink Movement Ability Usage | Hunter Class Ability Usage

Name: Overshield
Description:
Void Overshield with up to 45 HP for 10+5 seconds. Overshield has 70% Damage Resist against Combatants.

Damage dealt to Void Overshields does not stop Health Regeneration.
This applies to any Overshield.

Cannot gain Overshield while in a Healing Rift.

Name: Void Breach
Description:
Void Elemental Pickup.

Grants 12.5% Class Ability Energy on Pickup. Allies do not receive Void Breaches created by the user.
Lasts 25 seconds before disappearing. Incurs a 5 second cooldown between Void Breach spawns.

Name: Suppression
Description:
Suppressed Enemies are removed from active abilities and are unable to use abilities for 10 [5] seconds.

Suppressed Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants also become disoriented and will be unable to shoot.

Suppressed Guardians are removed from their active Super Ability and Transcendence, and cannot use Grenade, Melee, Class, Super, Movement Abilities, and Transcendence.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon being Suppressed.

Name: Volatile
Description:
Volatile Enemies trigger an explosion after being dealt 190 [200] damage or upon dying, dealing up to 145 [80] Void Ability Damage in a 5 meter radius.
Volatile lasts for 10 [6] seconds, harmlessly expiring afterwards. Debuff is removed after triggering the explosion.
The damage from the hit that applies Volatile doesn't count towards the detonation threshold. 

Incurs a 1 second cooldown before Volatile can be reapplied to an enemy after the explosion is triggered.

Name: Volatile Rounds
Description: Void Weapons inflict Volatile upon dealing damage, and Barrier Champion Shields are able to be damaged, stunning the Champion when destroyed while Volatile Rounds are active.

Name: Weaken
Description:
Weakened Enemies receive 15% [7.5%] increased damage and 20% Decreased Movement Speed for 6 [2.5] seconds.

Weakened Combatants become less accurate.

Unique Weaken Effects:
Certain sources of Weaken inflict a stronger Weaken that grants 30% [varies%] increased damage.

Shadowshot: Deadfall grants 35% [50%?] increased damage against tethered enemies.
Shadowshot: Moebius grants 30% [50%] increased damage against tethered enemies.
Felwinter's Helm's Warlord's End grants 30% [30%] increased damage against enemies affected by its weakening burst. Its duration can be extended by any other Weaken effect.
Tractor Cannon's Repulsor Force grants 30% [50%] increased damage against enemies it damages. Its duration can be extended by any other Weaken effect.

Name: Echo of Cessation
Description:
Finishers apply Volatile to enemies within ? metres.
Killing Volatile Enemies spawns a Void Breach.

Name: Echo of Dilation
Description:
Crouch Speed is set to 4 meters per second and grants doubled radar resolution while crouched.
Crouch Speed cannot be decreased below 4m/s, identically to Transversives Steps.

Name: Echo of Domineering
Description:
Suppressing an enemy grants +30 Weapons and 4% Forward Movement Speed Bonus for 10 seconds and refills the readied weapon.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown before it can be reactivated.

Killing Suppressed Enemies spawns a Void Breach.

Name: Echo of Exchange
Description:
Melee Kills grant Grenade Energy based on Enemy Rank.
 Tier 1 Combatants = 7.5%
Tier 2 Combatants = 11%
Tier 3 Combatants | Guardians = 16.25%
 Tier 4 Combatant | Minibosses | Bosses = 25%

Name: Echo of Expulsion
Description: Void Ability Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing up to 160 [130] damage in a 7 metre radius.

Name: Echo of Harvest
Description:
Killing Weakened Enemies creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy and a Void Breach.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown upon creating an Orb of Power.

Name: Echo of Instability
Description:
Grenade Kills grant Volatile Rounds to Void Weapons for 11.25 [7.5] seconds.
Does not require Void Grenade Kills.

Name: Echo of Leeching
Description: Melee Kills begin health regeneration for the user and allies within ? metres.

Name: Echo of Obscurity
Description: Finishers grant Invisibility for 5+2 seconds.

Name: Echo of Persistence
Description:
Void Buffs applied to the user last longer.
Devour: 50% Increased duration.
Invisibility: 40% increased duration.
Void Overshield: 50% increased duration.

Name: Echo of Provision
Description:
Grenade Ability Damage grants Melee Energy.
Can only activate once per damage instance. Hitting multiple enemies counts as 1 instance. Does not work with Unbreakable.

3% Melee Energy: Scatter, Spike, Voidwall, Vortex
8% Melee Energy: Axion, Handheld Supernova, Magnetic, Suppressor

Name: Echo of Remnants
Description:
Axion Bolts last ?% longer.
Void Spikes last 50% longer, and begin dealing damage 0.1 seconds earlier.
Void Wall last 50% longer.
Vortex Grenade last 25% longer, and begin dealing damage 0.13 seconds earlier.
Chaos Accelerant-enhanced Vortex Grenades last 55% longer.

Name: Echo of Reprisal
Description:
While surrounded by 3+ enemies within 8 meters:
Kills grant an additional ?% Super Energy.
Incurs a 1? second cooldown between activations.

Name: Echo of Starvation
Description:
On Orb of Power or Void Breach Pickup:
Grants Devour for 5+2.5 seconds.

Name: Echo of Undermining
Description: Void Grenades apply Weaken on hit for 6 [2.5] seconds.

Name: Echo of Vigilance
Description:
Upon killing an enemy while at Critical Health:
Grants Void Overshield for 5+2.5 seconds.
Incurs a 8 second cooldown after activating.

Name: Axion Bolt
Description:
Heavy Trajectory | Scan

Scans up to 2 enemies in Line of Sight within 10 metres upon impact, releasing a slow-moving Axion Bolt towards scanned enemies after a 1 second delay.

Axion Bolts deal 575 [65] damage and travel at a speed of ? m/s for up to ? seconds. Bolts have 10 HP and can be destroyed.

Name: Magnetic Grenade
Description:
Light Trajectory | Slightly Homing | Sticky | Fast

Attaches to enemies or surfaces, initially exploding after 1.2 seconds of being attached, followed by a secondary explosion after 0.6 seconds.

Each explosion deals up to 472 [75] damage over 5 meters on detonation.

Deals up to 946 [150] damage with both explosions.

Name: Scatter Grenade
Description:
Heavy Trajectory

Explodes on impact, dealing 5 [1] damage and releasing 8 submunitions over 4 meters.

Submunitions explode twice, each dealing up to 70 [16] damage over 4 meters on their first explosion.
After 0.5 seconds of exploding, each submunition detonates again, dealing up to 115 [20] damage over 4 meters on their second explosion.

Deals up to 1480 [288] damage with all 8 submunitions dealing their maximum damage.

Name: Suppressor Grenade
Description:
Medium Trajectory

Explodes after its speed is sufficiently reduced. Has a brief delay before it can explode.

Explosion deals up to 863 [150] damage and inflicts Suppression for 10 [5] seconds over 9 meters on detonation.
The user is immune to self-suppression.

Name: Void Spike
Description:
Medium Trajectory | Wall-Mounted

Attaches to surfaces and enemies, projecting a torrent of Void Light after 0.67-0.1 seconds.

Void Light deals 80 [28] damage every 0.217 seconds up to 16+9 times over 3.5+1.75 seconds.

Void Light deals up to 1280 [2000] [448 [700]] over its duration.

Name: Void Wall
Description:
Medium Trajectory | DoT Field

Explodes on impact, creating a perpendicular wall of Void Light over ? meters that deals up to 173 [46] damage as it spreads.

After 0.85 seconds of being created, Void Light deals 120 [35] damage every 0.2 seconds up to 18+9 times over its 3.75+1.875 second duration

Void Light deals up to 2160 [3240] [630 [945]] damage over its duration.

Name: Vortex Grenade
Description:
Medium Trajectory | DoT Field

Deals up to 195 [25] damage over 5 metres on impact, as well as creating a Void Vortex. 

Void Vortex
Pulls enemies within 5? meters after 0.833 seconds of impacting.
After 1.45-0.13 seconds of being created, deals 78 [20] damage every 0.267 seconds up to 12+7 times over its 4+1 second duration to enemies within its 4 meter radius.
The 13th 20th tick has falloff and deals up to 54 [?] damage.

Deals up to 990 [1536] [240 [380]] damage with the Void Vortex field.

Name: Snare Bomb
Description:
Smoke Bomb that attaches to surfaces for up to 9 seconds. Pings Enemy Radar while attached.

Bomb explodes upon detecting an enemy within ? meters of it, or upon directly striking an enemy, creating a cloud of smoke.

Snare Bomb deals 33 [10] impact damage, and up to 120 + 24 [40 + ?] explosion damage over ? meters. Impact and explosion weaken and disorient for 8 [2.5] seconds.

Smoke Cloud
Lasts for 5 [2] seconds on detonation, dealing DoT every 0.6 seconds and disorienting enemies.
Deals DoT after 0.87 seconds, starting at 12.65 [?] damage, increasing by 13% per tick, up to 24.8 [?] damage on its last 9th tick, dealing up to 156.7 [?] damage over 5 seconds.

Name: Spectral Blades
Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [59?% Invisible | 58% Visible]
Base Duration: 23.5 seconds or 4.25% Super Drain per second. Drains 50% faster if not invisible.

Light Attack
Drains 5?% Super Energy.
Deals 1107 [?] damage and removes Void Invisibility.
Attacks ? times per second. Uninterrupted hits against enemies grants up to 25?% Increased Melee Attack Speed

Heavy Attack
Drains 15?% Super Energy.
[Heavy Attack] performs an uppercut, dealing 1620 [?] damage and applying Weaken and granting Invisibility.

Allows unlimited Trapper's Ambush usage, at the cost of 15%? Super Energy.

Name: Shadowshot: Deadfall
Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [53%]

Shadowshot fires a single Deadfall Anchor that attaches to surfaces and enemies, pulling all enemies within 12.5 metres towards it upon impact. 
Void Anchor activates on a 1 second delay after it detects an enemy within 12.5 metres, or automatically after 30 seconds have passed.

Deadfall Anchor:
Deals 2,583 [?] Damage on impact, inflicting Deadfall Weaken and Suppression to enemies within ? meters. Counts as a Construct with ? HP.
Enemies within 12.5 meters of the anchor are tethered. Tethered enemies are inflicted with Deadfall Weaken, Suppression, and Mark for 30 [10] seconds.
50% of the Bodyshot (Base) Damage dealt to tethered enemies is also inflicted to other tethered enemies.

Deadfall Weaken UNIQUELY increases damage taken by 35%.

Deadfall Anchor lasts for 12 seconds by default. Tethered Enemy kills increase its duration by 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 25 seconds.

Name: Shadowshot: Moebius Quiver
Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [53%]
Super Duration: 16 seconds [20 with Orpheus Rigs]

Shadowshot fires 3 Moebius Anchors up to 2 times per activation.
Dealing damage while Shadowshot is active linearly grants increased Moebius Anchor and Bow Weapon Damage.
Maxes out at 127% increased Moebius Anchor Damage and 150% increased Bow Weapon Damage after dealing ~3000 damage.
Damage requirement IGNORES Power-Delta, but considers ACTUAL DAMAGE DEALT.

Moebius Anchor:
Deals 1076 [?] Damage and inflicts Suppression, Volatile, and Weaken on impact. Counts as a Construct with ? HP.
Enemies within 7 meters of the anchor are tethered. Deals 20% increased damage to tethered enemies. Tethered enemies are inflicted with Weaken and Suppression.
50% of the Bodyshot (Base) Damage dealt to tethered enemies is also inflicted to other tethered enemies.

Moebius Anchor lasts for 6 seconds by default. Tethered Enemy kills increase its duration by 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 25 seconds.

Name: On The Prowl
Description:
Upon gaining Void Invisibility:
Marks [Highlights] a Non-Boss Enemy within 45 [25] meters as a Priority Target.
Grants On The Prowl buff while a Priority Target is alive. Priority Target receives the Pursuit Predation debuff indefinitely [for 15 seconds].
Prioritizes marking Rank-and-File Combatants closer to the reticle.

Upon killing a Priority Target:
Releases a weakening cloud of smoke on Enemy Death Location.
Grants a stack of Succesful Hunt for ? seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks, as well as ?% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy.

Succesful Hunt x1 | +? Stability, +? Reload Speed, and 0.?x Reload Duration Multiplier
Succesful Hunt x2 | +? Stability, +? Reload Speed, and 0.?x Reload Duration Multiplier
Succesful Hunt x3 | +? Stability, +? Reload Speed, and 0.?x Reload Duration Multiplier

Cloud of smoke:
Instantly deals up to 133 [?] Void Damage over ? meters.
Enemies that come in contact with the smoke are weakened for 6? seconds and disoriented while inside the cloud. The user and allies gain Void Invisibility for 5+2 seconds.
Lingers for 7? seconds over ? meters, dealing scaling DoT every 0.6 seconds.
Deals DoT after 0.87 seconds, starting at 12.65 [?] damage, increasing by ?% per tick, up to 24.8 [?] damage on the 9th tick, dealing up to ? [?] damage over 7 seconds.
Functionally, the cloud of smoke is a Snare Bomb that is instantly detonated, with a larger radius and duration. It even procs melee-related effects.

Name: Stylish Executioner
Description:
Killing Void-Debuffed Enemies grants Invisibility for 8+3.2 seconds, and Truesight for 4 seconds.

While invisible from activating Stylish Execution:
Melee Attacks deal 300% [20%] increased damage, weaken enemies for 5 [2.5] seconds, and have their Melee Lunge Range extended to ? metres.

Applies "Too Stylish" after Stylish Executioner is triggered, preventing additional Stylish Execution activations for 2 [12] seconds.

Name: Trapper's Ambush
Description:
[Air Move] activates Quickfall, spending a Melee Charge to dive and create a Smoke Cloud upon landing with a longer smoke duration of 6 seconds.

Enemies caught by the Smoke Cloud are dealt 200 [50] Void Damage and become weakened for 10 [5] seconds. 
Allies caught by the Smoke Cloud become invisible for 6.5 seconds.

Snare Bombs grant Invisibility to allies within 6 meters of its impact for 5+2 seconds.

Name: Vanishing Step
Description: Replaces Dodge Animation with a faster, farther traveling Dodge Animation that grants Invisibility for 5+2 seconds.

Name: Shield Bash
Description:
Shared with other Shoulder Charge Abilities:
Requires sprinting for 1.25 seconds. Drains 15% Melee Ability Energy if no enemy is hit. Unable to use during slide if user shoots. 
Guardians directly hit by Shoulder Charge have their Melee Lunge disabled for 0.5 seconds
Lunges forward 6.8 meters, automatically targeting enemies in range.

Hitting an enemy deals 595 [110] damage, as well as dealing up to 216 [40] radial damage and applying Suppression to enemies within 2 meters.

Scoring a kill with Shield Bash grants 45 HP Void Overshield for 10+5 seconds.

Name: Shield Throw
Description:
Hurls a Void Shield forward. Ricochets up to 4 times per throw, attempts to home in towards enemies, and is affected by gravity.

Shield deals 400 [70] impact damage on hit, and grants 15 HP Void Overshield per hit.

Name: Sentinel Shield
Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [53%]
Base Duration: 17 seconds or 5.88% Super Drain per second.

Light Attack
Drains 4.5% Super Energy per Attack. The Final Hit in the combo drains 2% Super Energy.
Grounded 3-Hit Combo, dealing 797 [?] and 856 [?] damage. 
Airborne 2-Hit Combo, dealing 797 [?] damage
The Final Hit in a combo deals 1516 [?] damage in a ? metre cone.

Heavy Attack
Generates an impenetrable barrier that allies can shoot through, at the cost of 20% Decreased Movement Speed.
Enemies that touch the barrier receive 7 [?] Damage every 0.05 seconds.
Blocking ? [any] damage generates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5?% Super Energy. Incurs a 1.5 second cooldown between Orb of Power spawns.
Enhances Shield Throw Damage as more damage is blocked, up to 1787% increased damage after blocking ? damage.
Extends Super Duration by up to ?% by continuously blocking damage.

Allies standing within 5m behind the barrier are granted 25% Increased Damage, a 45 HP Void Overshield, +50 Handling, and +50 Reload Speed. 
Additionally, all of their weapons are refilled every 2.5 seconds.
Ally's Void Overshield begins regenerating at a rate of 9HP/s after not receiving damage for 3 seconds.

Passive Super Energy Drain while Blocking can be decreased by having allies behind the shield.
x1 = 20% | x2 = 35% | x3 = ?% | x4 = ?% | x5 = 50%

Grenade Ability
Does not drain Super Energy. Incurs a 3 second cooldown between Shield Throws.
Performs a Shield Throw, tossing the Sentinel Shield towards enemies.
Sentinel Shield deals 723 [?] damage, and can ricochet on impact, up to ? times. Ricochets are aimed towards enemies within ? meters.

Name: Twilight Arsenal
Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance while in Cast Animation: ?% [%]

Summons 3 Void Axes and throws them towards the reticle.
Axes deal up to 1250 [?] damage over ? meters on impact, pulling enemies inwards, and explode after 0.6 seconds, dealing up to 1750 [?] damage and weakening over ? meters.
After exploding, axes become carriable weapons, lingering up to 20 seconds on the ground.

Carriable Axes:
Melee Weapons with 10 Ammo that can be held for up to 15 seconds.
Light Attack swings deal 581 [175] damage and weaken, consuming 1 Ammo.
Heavy Attacks throws the axe as an explosive projectile, consuming all ammo, dealing 1337 [?] damage on impact, and up to 830 [250] damage over ? meters with its explosion, weakening damaged enemies.
Axe damage can only be increased through the Void Surge modifier and debuffs.

Name: Ward of Dawn
Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance while in Cast Animation: ?% [26.5%]
Grants 1 Grenade Ability Charge and creates 3 Orbs of Power that each grant 2.3% Super Energy on Super Cast.

Ward of Dawn:
Construct with 8,000 HP. Guardian Weapons deal 50% increased damage towards it, and abilities are uniquely tweaked.
Projects a dome-shaped barrier with a 3 meter radius that blocks incoming and outgoing projectiles, prevents damage from the outside, and continuously generates 16.5 [11] HP Void Overshield per second to allies within ? meters outside of it.
Inflicts Weaken to enemies within 6 meters on cast.
Combatants deal 0.25x Damage against the Ward of Dawn.

Being inside the dome grants Void Overshield, 60% [30%] Damage Resist, +50 Handling, and +50 Reload Speed.
Void Overshield regenerates at a rate of 49.5HP/s after 3 seconds of not receiving damage while inside the dome.
Combatants up to ? meters away are taunted towards Guardians inside the dome.
Caster can generate up to 5? Orbs of Power by scoring Melee Kills while within the dome.

Name: Bastion
Description:
On Super Cast:
Grants allies within 15 metres a 45 HP Void Overshield.

On Enhanced Barricade Cast:
Grants a 45 HP Overshield for the user and allies within 15? metres 
Enhanced Barricade takes 20% increased damage from Guardians.

While behind the Enhanced Barricade:
Generates 11 Void Overshield HP per second.

Crucible-Only:
Overrides Towering Barricade Cooldown to 100 seconds at base.
Overrides Rally Barricade Cooldown to 80 seconds at base.

Name: Controlled Demolition
Description:
Dealing Void Ability Damage inflicts Volatile.
Volatile Explosions also count as Void Ability Damage.

Upon triggering a Volatile Explosion:
Restores 90 HP. 
Allies within 40 meters, centered on the user, are also granted health.

Name: Offensive Bulwark
Description:
Grants an additional Shield Throw to Sentinel Shield Super.

While Void Overshield is active or while affected by a Ward of Dawn's Armor of Light:
400% [200%] Additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate, 160% [20%] increased Melee Damage, and increases Melee Lunge Range to 5.5 metres.
Melee Kills generate 10? HP Void Overshield.
Unpowered Melee Hits count as Powered Void Melee Hits, except for Doomfang Pauldrons.

Name: Unbreakable
Description:
Hold [Grenade] to summon a Void Shield. 
Overrides Grenade Ability Cooldown to 152 seconds at base while equipped.

Void Shield:
Grants 95?% [75?%] Damage Resist against blocked damage, and taunts Combatants in front of the user. Combatants that come into contact with the shield become disoriented.
Continuously generates ? Void Overshield HP/s. Void Overshield lasts for 5+2.5 seconds.
Drains 50% Grenade Energy over 1 second, then 25% Grenade Energy per second.
Blocking damage decreases Forward Movement Speed by 50?% for 0.5? seconds.
Blocking damage grants ?% Fixed Grenade Energy. Energy gains are progressively reduced (over time) OR (as Unbreakable gains damage)?, down to ?% Energy after ? seconds.

While Sentinel Shield Super Ability is equipped:
Guarding against any damage spawns an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy to allies.
Incurs a 4.5 second cooldown between Orb of Power spawns.

Releasing [Grenade] or running out of Grenade Energy releases a frontal blast, consuming 50% Grenade Energy and dealing damage up to 11 meters away.
Deals a minimum of 495 [64?] damage for not blocking any damage, linearly scaling to 2760? [178?] damage after receiving a lot [?] blocked damage.

Name: Pocket Singularity
Description:
Innately has 2 Melee Ability Charges.

Launches an unstable ball of Void Energy that lasts for 2 seconds.

Singularity homes in towards the closest enemy within 2? meters, exploding on contact.

Explosion knocks enemies within 3.75 meters away from the blast, dealing 527 [60] damage and inflicting Volatile.

Guardians hit by Pocket Singularity cannot perform Melee Lunges for 0.5 second, and interrupts active slides.

Name: Nova Bomb: Cataclysm
Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [49%]

Releases a slowly moving, tracking Nova Bomb that detonates on impact, or upon being detonated, dealing up to 3600 [?] damage in a ? meter radius.
Nova Bomb has 400 Construct HP. Caster deals 300% increased damage towards their own Nova Bomb.

Releases 6 seekers on detonation, which slowly track enemies, dealing up to 720 [?] damage in a small radius each.
Seekers have 100 Construct HP.

Nova Bomb and its Seekers can be detonated mid-air by dealing damage towards it. Caster deals significantly more damage against it.

Name: Nova Bomb: Vortex
Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [49%]

Releases a fast moving, arcing Nova Bomb that detonates on impact, dealing up to 3358 [?] damage in a ? meter radius.
Creates a singularity after 0.43 seconds of detonating, instantly pulling enemies inwards.

Singularity deals 57 [?] damage every 0.13 seconds for 10 seconds to enemies within ? metres, and repeatedly pulls enemies within ? meters every ? seconds towards it.

Name: Nova Warp
Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [58%]
Base Duration: 24.5 seconds, or 4.1% Super Drain per second.

Light Attack
Drains 5% Super Energy.
Deals up to 963? [200] damage, and inflicting Volatile in a 5 metre radius. Maximum Damage Falloff reduces damage by up to 50%.
Can be charged by holding [Fire] for 0.6 seconds, pulling enemies within ~14 meters towards the user and linearly increasing its damage by up to 120%, and its radius by up to ?%.
Decreases Movement Speed by ?% while charging.

Heavy Attack / Sprint
Performs a Dark Blink, draining 3.5% Super Energy to rapidly accelerate towards the currently input direction and release 4 Weakening Seekers, one in each cardinal direction.
Weakening Seekers target enemies within 5 meters, dealing 220 [?] Damage and inflicting Weaken on impact.

Name: Child of the Old Gods
Description:
On Rift Cast:
Grants Void Soul Ready for 25 seconds. Can stack up to 2 Void Souls.

Scoring a Weapon Hit on an enemy launches the Void Buddy to fly towards them, projecting a Draining Field upon arriving.
The Draining Field deals 43 [10] Void Grenade Ability Damage and inflicts weaken for 4 [2.5] seconds every 0.7 seconds for up to 9.25 seconds to enemies within 10 meters. 
The Void Friend has 150 HP and can be, unfortunately, destroyed. Has ?% Damage Resist until it is actively draining.

Grants different bonuses while the Void Soul is dealing damage, depending on the selected Class Ability:
Healing Rift: Grants 4% Grenade and Melee Energy every 1.4 seconds.
Empowering Rift: Restores 25 HP every 1.4 seconds.

Enemies killed within its Draining Field grant Class Ability Energy based on their Enemy Rank:
Tier 1 Combatant = 10% | T2 = 15% | T3 = 20% | T4+ = 50% | Guardian = 33.4%

Name: Chaos Accelerant
Description:
[Grenade Ability] to overcharge a Grenade, enhancing it.

Grants an extra Grenade Ability Charge.

Overcharged Grenade Effects:

Axion Bolt: Adds 2 additional seekers [2 -> 4], seekers travel faster, deal 25% increased damage, and retriggers after a second of landing.

Scatter: Adds 4 additional submunitions, totalling 12. Submunitions now strongly track enemies within 5 meters, and deal 25% increased damage towards Combatants.

Vortex: 7.5% Increased Duration, 70% Increased Radius, begins dealing damage 0.275s sooner, and pulls enemies 0.2s earlier.

Magnetic, Spike, Suppressor, and Voidwall: Releases a short-range Void Blast that inflicts Volatile. Passively grants 1.15x Grenade Regeneration Speed.

Name: Feed the Void
Description:
Void Ability Kills grant Devour. 
Devour becomes Enhanced Devour.

Enhanced Devour:
Restores 140 HP on activation and grants Enhanced Devour for 10+5 seconds. Reactivating Enhanced Devour restores 140 HP and refreshes 5+3 seconds.
Scoring a kill while Enhanced Devour is active restores 140 HP, grants doubled Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5+3 seconds of its duration.

Grenade Ability Energy on Kill:
Tier 1 Combatant = 15% | T2 = 23.2% | T3 = 27.5% | T4 = 40% | Guardians = 40%
